---
title: "Rich text labels with md()"
description: "Markdown markup in titles and axis names: bold, italic, superscript, and subscript via md()."
categories: [Text]
---



Wrap a label in `md()` and it accepts a small slice of Markdown: `**bold**`,
`*italic*`, `^superscript^`, and `~subscript~`. It works anywhere a label does,
including plot titles, subtitles, and axis names. Superscripts and subscripts
earn their keep on units and formulae, like m^2^ or CO~2~.


::: {.cell}

```{.r .cell-code}
peng <- na.omit(datasets::penguins)

p <- vplot(peng) |>
  mark_point(x = bill_len, y = body_mass, color = species, size = 2) |>
  labs(
    title = md("**Body mass** of *Pygoscelis* penguins"),
    subtitle = md("Axis titles carry markup too: **bold**, *italic*, super/subscript"),
    y = md("Body mass (kg x 10^3^)"),
    x = md("Bill length (*mm*)"),
    color = "Species"
  )
```
